title: Alwaai Hayat
description: Alwaai Hayat, literally "Awareness is Life," is a life coaching organization directed at new parents, newly married couples, and individuals who feel lost in life. Its purpose is to guide people through some of life's most disorienting transitions toward a clearer, more grounded sense of self.
direction: The identity is built with the same intention an NGO would carry: simple, multicolored, and strong. Nothing about it needed to be complicated, the message itself, awareness and renewal, had to come through at a glance.

The logo is a modern depiction of a lotus flower, a symbol that in ancient Egypt represented rebirth and renewal, life beginning again after recreation. Drawn the way it is here, the lotus doubles as a rising sun, a more universal signal for a new day. The open, multi lined leaves carry a second meaning too, they read like open arms, welcoming and reassuring, which is exactly the feeling the brand wants someone to have the moment they consider reaching out for help.
